630680256092.explanation_en: 'Horizontal' has a single r and 'referred' doubles the r before -ed because the stress falls on the final syllable (re-FER). Only option 3 spells both words correctly; the others contain 'horrizontal', 'refferred' or 'refered'.

630680256095.explanation_en: 'You can't have your cake and eat it too' means you cannot enjoy two mutually contradictory advantages at once - once the cake is eaten, you no longer have it. Hence option 4, being unable to do two contradictory things, is the correct meaning.

630680256083.explanation_en: Sentence 4 introduces the topic (road safety rules), 2 gives the statistic on rule-breakers causing accidents, 1 adds 'however' that change needs collective effort, and 3 concludes with the benefit of following rules. So the order 4-2-1-3 (option 3) is coherent.

630680256090.explanation_en: 'Propensity' means a natural tendency or inclination to behave in a certain way. Its opposite is 'disinclination' (unwillingness); aptness and disposition are near-synonyms and competence is unrelated.

630680256086.explanation_en: An egoist is a self-centred person who pursues his own interest and self-aggrandisement (enlarging his own power or importance). An altruist is the opposite, an introvert is shy, and an iconoclast attacks established beliefs, so 'Egoist' fits.

630680256096.explanation_en: A noun used as a modifier here must be 'detection', not the verb 'detect': the correct phrase is 'The ideal detection dog'. The other segments ('is extremely energetic', 'with an excessive play drive') are grammatical, so segment 1 has the error.

630680256088.explanation_en: 'Barely/Hardly/Scarcely ... when' expresses one past action immediately followed by another, so it takes the past perfect with inversion: 'Barely had they won the match when...'. 'Has' is wrong for a past context and 'did ... won' is ungrammatical, so option 4 is correct.

630680256097.explanation_en: The verb 'engage' takes the preposition 'in' when it means to take part in an activity: 'engage in dust bathing'. 'Engage on' is incorrect, so segment 4 contains the error.

630680256089.explanation_en: 'Read between the lines' is a fixed collocation meaning to understand the hidden or implied meaning. The other prepositions do not form this idiom, so option 4 is correct.

630680256093.explanation_en: The correct spellings are 'conservation', 'canines', 'indispensable' and 'biologists'. Only option 1 has all of them correct; the others contain 'cannines', 'indispensible', 'biologicsts', 'conversatoin' or 'indespensible'.

630680256087.explanation_en: 'No sooner ... than' is followed by the past perfect with subject-auxiliary inversion: 'No sooner had + subject + V3'. So 'had the company launch' must become 'had the company launched' (option 2); 'did ... launched' and 'have the company' are ungrammatical.

630680256094.explanation_en: 'Blow off steam' means to release pent-up energy or strong emotions such as anger, often through activity. Option 2 states exactly this idiomatic sense.

630680256084.explanation_en: Sentence 2 introduces cataract as a major cause of blindness, 4 says it occurs more often in old age, 1 explains that the eye lens hardens and becomes opaque with ageing, and 3 says this blocks light rays. Hence 2-4-1-3 (option 2).

630680256085.explanation_en: Gerontology is the scientific study of ageing and of the problems of old people (Greek geron = old man). Chronology is the order of events, genealogy the study of family lineage, and microbiology the study of microbes.

630680256091.explanation_en: 'Waves' fits both blanks with different meanings: 'she waves her hands' (verb: moves in greeting) and 'the huge waves of ocean' (noun: moving ridges of water). The other words do not suit both blanks.

630680256103.explanation_en: The writer narrates personal experiences in chronological order and describes places and languages in detail, without sadness or pretence. Hence the tone is narrative and descriptive (option 3).

630680256099.explanation_en: The passage links the author's travels to the growth of his interest in French, Spanish and Chinese. 'Travel and Language' captures both themes, while the other titles cover only a part or are unrelated.

630680256102.explanation_en: 'Incredible' (used in 'This was incredible to me') means impossible to believe, i.e. unbelievable. 'Amazed' and 'bewildered' describe feelings and 'enthusiasm' means eagerness, so option 3 is correct.

630680256101.explanation_en: 'Ordinary' means common or usual; its opposite is 'unique' (one of a kind), used in 'Each has given me a unique learning experience'. The other words describe states of wonder or confusion.

630680256100.explanation_en: The passage says 'At thirteen, I saw ... Stonehenge and walked along the Great Wall of China, amazed...'. The Eiffel Tower was at five and Piazza San Marco at eight, so option 2 is correct.

630680256104.explanation_en: Standard Hindi word order is subject - object (with its modifiers) - verb. 'Janta shasak ki agya ka palan karti hai' follows this order; the others misplace the verb or object.
630680256104.explanation_hi: हिंदी वाक्य-विन्यास का सामान्य क्रम है - कर्ता + कर्म (विशेषण/संबंधवाचक सहित) + क्रिया। 'जनता शासक की आज्ञा का पालन करती है' में कर्ता 'जनता' पहले, कर्म 'शासक की आज्ञा का पालन' बीच में और क्रिया 'करती है' अंत में है, अतः विकल्प 3 शुद्ध है।

630680256111.explanation_en: By visarga sandhi, nih + rog gives 'neerog' (the visarga drops before r and the preceding i becomes long), just like 'neeras'. So 'nirog' is the incorrect form; the other words are correctly spelt.
630680256111.explanation_hi: विसर्ग संधि के नियम से 'निः' के बाद 'र' आने पर विसर्ग लुप्त हो जाता है और पूर्व का ह्रस्व स्वर दीर्घ हो जाता है - निः + रोग = नीरोग (जैसे नीरस, नीरव)। अतः 'निरोग' अशुद्ध है; सशक्त, निर्दोष और अतीन्द्रिय शुद्ध हैं।

630680256116.explanation_en: 'Samanjit' means adjusted or harmonised; its opposite is formed by adding the negative prefix 'a-': 'asamanjit'. 'Samayojit' is a synonym, and 'manjit/amanjit' drop the 'sam' root.
630680256116.explanation_hi: 'समंजित' का अर्थ है - ठीक से मेल बिठाया हुआ, सुव्यवस्थित। इसका विलोम 'अ' उपसर्ग जोड़कर 'असमंजित' बनता है। 'समायोजित' इसका पर्यायवाची है, अतः विकल्प 4 सही है।

630680256114.explanation_en: The correct idiom is 'os ka moti hona', meaning something short-lived or perishable, as a dew drop shines like a pearl but vanishes quickly. Hence the underlined word should be replaced with 'moti'.
630680256114.explanation_hi: सही मुहावरा है 'ओस का मोती होना', जिसका अर्थ है - क्षणभंगुर होना या शीघ्र नष्ट हो जाना। ओस की बूँद मोती-सी चमकती है पर जल्दी उड़ जाती है, अतः 'पानी' के स्थान पर 'मोती' शब्द उचित है।

630680256110.explanation_en: 'Bhaskar' is a visarga sandhi: bhaah + kar = bhaskar, where the visarga before 'k' changes to 's'. So the correct split is 'bhaah + kar' (option 3).
630680256110.explanation_hi: 'भास्कर' विसर्ग संधि का उदाहरण है - भाः + कर = भास्कर। यहाँ 'क' से पहले विसर्ग 'स्' में बदल गया है (जैसे नमः + कार = नमस्कार)। अतः शुद्ध संधि-विच्छेद 'भाः + कर' है।

630680256105.explanation_en: Option 1 follows the normal Hindi order of subject (Angad ne) - indirect object (Ravan se) - object (do took baat) - verb (kahi), followed by a proper 'ki' clause. The other sentences jumble the order of subject, object and verb.
630680256105.explanation_hi: विकल्प 1 में कर्ता (अंगद ने), गौण कर्म (रावण से), कर्म (दो टूक बात) और क्रिया (कही) अपने सही क्रम में हैं तथा 'कि' से आश्रित उपवाक्य भी उचित स्थान पर है। अन्य वाक्यों में कर्ता, कर्म और क्रिया का क्रम बिगड़ा हुआ है, अतः विकल्प 1 का पदक्रम शुद्ध है।

630680256117.explanation_en: 'Lashun' is the Sanskrit (tatsam) form of the everyday word 'lahsun'. Harad (from hareetaki), haldi (from haridra) and heeng (from hingu) are tadbhav words, so option 2 is the tatsam word.
630680256117.explanation_hi: 'लशुन' संस्कृत का तत्सम शब्द है, जिसका तद्भव रूप 'लहसुन' है। हरड़ (हरीतकी), हल्दी (हरिद्रा) और हींग (हिंगु) तद्भव शब्द हैं। अतः रिक्त स्थान में तत्सम शब्द 'लशुन' उपयुक्त है।

630680256106.explanation_en: Shraddha (reverence) is an emotion or feeling, and Acharya Ramchandra Shukla famously described it as a social emotion ('samajik bhav'). Prabhav (influence), pravanchana (deceit) and apradh (crime) do not fit the sense.
630680256106.explanation_hi: श्रद्धा एक मनोभाव है; आचार्य रामचंद्र शुक्ल ने अपने निबंध 'श्रद्धा-भक्ति' में इसे सामाजिक भाव कहा है। 'प्रभाव', 'प्रवंचना' (छल) और 'अपराध' अर्थ की दृष्टि से उपयुक्त नहीं हैं, अतः 'भाव' सही है।

630680256115.explanation_en: 'Khang' (khadg) is a synonym of 'talwar' (sword), along with asi, kripan and chandrahas. Chaap means bow, keer means parrot and kumbhil means crocodile.
630680256115.explanation_hi: 'खंग' (खड्ग) 'तलवार' का पर्यायवाची है; अन्य पर्याय हैं - असि, कृपाण, करवाल, चन्द्रहास। 'चाप' धनुष का, 'कीर' तोते का और 'कुम्भिल' मगरमच्छ का पर्याय है।

630680256107.explanation_en: 'Anugami' (anu = after, gami = one who goes) means one who follows or walks behind. Mitra is a friend and sahyatri a co-traveller; anuvarti suggests an obedient follower of rules, so 'anugami' fits best.
630680256107.explanation_hi: 'अनुगामी' (अनु = पीछे + गामी = चलने वाला) का अर्थ है पीछे-पीछे चलने वाला। 'मित्र' का अर्थ दोस्त और 'सहयात्री' का अर्थ साथ यात्रा करने वाला है, अतः विकल्प 1 सही है।

630680256118.explanation_en: 'Mauka' (opportunity) comes from Arabic, so it is a foreign-origin (videshaj) word. Saath is tadbhav, while darshan and samay are tatsam words of Sanskrit origin.
630680256118.explanation_hi: 'मौका' अरबी भाषा से आया शब्द है, अतः यह विदेशज शब्द है। 'साथ' तद्भव तथा 'दर्शन' और 'समय' संस्कृत के तत्सम शब्द हैं।

630680256112.explanation_en: 'Vishdhar' literally means one who holds poison, but it refers to a third entity - the snake - so it is a bahuvrihi compound. In bahuvrihi neither member is primary; together they point to something else.
630680256112.explanation_hi: 'विषधर' का विग्रह 'विष को धारण करता है जो' अर्थात् साँप है। जब दोनों पद मिलकर किसी तीसरे (अन्य) अर्थ की ओर संकेत करें, तो बहुव्रीहि समास होता है; अतः विकल्प 2 सही है।

630680256108.explanation_en: 'Agraj' (agra = before, ja = born) means one born earlier, i.e. an elder brother. Anuj is the younger one, purvaj means ancestor, and purvagami means one who went before.
630680256108.explanation_hi: 'अग्रज' (अग्र = पहले + ज = जन्मा) का अर्थ है पहले पैदा होने वाला, अर्थात् बड़ा भाई। 'अनुज' बाद में जन्मा, 'पूर्वज' पुरखे और 'पूर्वगामी' पहले जाने वाला होता है।

630680256113.explanation_en: The lines have a simile ('madira si', 'prabhuta si') which is an arthalankar, and also the repetition of sounds like 'm' and 's' (anupras), which is a shabdalankar. Since both types are present, it is an ubhayalankar.
630680256113.explanation_hi: इन पंक्तियों में 'मदिरा सी', 'प्रभुता सी' में उपमा (अर्थालंकार) है और 'म', 'स' वर्णों की आवृत्ति से अनुप्रास (शब्दालंकार) भी है। जहाँ शब्द और अर्थ दोनों के अलंकार एक साथ हों, वहाँ उभयालंकार होता है।

630680256109.explanation_en: Rags (chithde) are naturally described as torn and old, so 'phate-purane' is the apt adjective. The other pairs (proper-improper, new-old, front-back) do not suit rags.
630680256109.explanation_hi: 'चिथड़े' फटे हुए पुराने कपड़ों को कहते हैं, अतः उनके लिए उपयुक्त विशेषण 'फटे-पुराने' है। अन्य विशेषण-युग्म अर्थ की दृष्टि से संगत नहीं हैं।

630680256121.explanation_en: Aalochana (criticism) has synonyms such as samiksha, mimansa and nirupan (critical analysis). 'Kathopakathan' means dialogue or conversation, so it is not a synonym.
630680256121.explanation_hi: 'आलोचना' के पर्याय हैं - समीक्षा, मीमांसा, निरूपण, विवेचन। 'कथोपकथन' का अर्थ है संवाद या वार्तालाप, अतः यह आलोचना का पर्यायवाची नहीं है।

630680256124.explanation_en: The passage says Vajpeyi reviewed Chhayavadi poetry in detail and helped establish it, and calls him basically a Chhayavadi and romantic critic. So he was a supporter of Chhayavad.
630680256124.explanation_hi: गद्यांश में कहा गया है कि वाजपेयी जी ने छायावादी काव्य की विस्तृत समीक्षा कर उसे प्रतिष्ठित कराने में योगदान दिया और वे मूलतः छायावादी एवं स्वच्छंदतावादी समीक्षक हैं। अतः वे छायावाद के समर्थक हैं।

630680256122.explanation_en: The passage states that Hazari Prasad Dwivedi, discussing the power of Kabir's language, called him 'vani ka dictator'. Hence option 1.
630680256122.explanation_hi: गद्यांश के अनुसार कबीर की भाषा की शक्ति पर विचार करते हुए हजारी प्रसाद द्विवेदी ने उन्हें 'वाणी का डिक्टेटर' कहा है। अतः विकल्प 1 सही है।

630680256120.explanation_en: 'Ujagar karna' means to reveal or bring to light; in the passage the works 'reveal' Dwivedi's deep thinking. So 'prakat' (manifest) is the meaning.
630680256120.explanation_hi: 'उजागर' का अर्थ है प्रकट या स्पष्ट करना। गद्यांश में कृतियाँ द्विवेदी जी के गंभीर चिंतन को 'उजागर' अर्थात् प्रकट करती हैं, अतः विकल्प 3 सही है।

630680256123.explanation_en: The passage discusses two critics who came after Acharya Ramchandra Shukla - Nanddulare Vajpeyi and Hazari Prasad Dwivedi. A title covering only one of them is too narrow, so 'Shukla parvarti Hindi aalochana' is most suitable.
630680256123.explanation_hi: गद्यांश में आचार्य रामचंद्र शुक्ल के बाद के दो आलोचकों - नंददुलारे वाजपेयी और हजारी प्रसाद द्विवेदी - की चर्चा है। केवल एक आलोचक पर आधारित शीर्षक अधूरा होगा, अतः 'शुक्ल परवर्ती हिन्दी आलोचना' सर्वाधिक उपयुक्त शीर्षक है।

630680256218.explanation_en: Gopal Hari Deshmukh, the 19th-century Maharashtrian social reformer, wrote under the pen name 'Lokhitwadi' through his 'Shatapatre' letters on social reform. Hence option 2.

630680256220.explanation_en: A unit plan involves organising content into suitable units and sub-units (when the syllabus does not give them) and deciding the methods of assessment/evaluation for the unit. Both steps are part of the procedure, so option 1.

630680256221.explanation_en: David Kolb's learning-style model rests on his Experiential Learning Theory, a four-stage cycle of concrete experience, reflective observation, abstract conceptualisation and active experimentation. Hence experiential learning.

630680256216.explanation_en: Piaget used 'horizontal decalage' for the uneven acquisition of conservation tasks - a child conserves number first, then mass, weight and volume later, though the same logic applies. So option 1.

630680256219.explanation_en: The heuristic (discovery) method, in which the learner finds things out for himself, was introduced by H. E. Armstrong. The word comes from Greek 'heurisko', meaning 'I find out'.

630680256215.explanation_en: Developmental research (Fantz and others) shows newborns can discriminate black-and-white stripes about 1/8 inch wide, and visual acuity improves rapidly so that around three months infants detect much narrower stripes (about 1/64 inch). Thus both statements are treated as correct.

630680256217.explanation_en: Children model the relationships they experience at home: when parents maintain a reciprocal, give-and-take relationship, children show similar cooperative relationships with peers. The other pairings are mismatched (e.g. clear communication leads to well-liked children).

630680256222.explanation_en: Broca's area (speech production) and Wernicke's area (language comprehension) are located in the left cerebral hemisphere in most people. Hence only statement II is correct.

630680256223.explanation_en: Neo-Freudians kept Freud's basic ideas but stressed social and cultural factors. Both Harry Stack Sullivan's interpersonal theory and Erik Erikson's psychosocial theory are neo-Freudian, so neither is 'not neo-Freudian' (option 3).

630680256224.explanation_en: A teacher who participates in solving the community's real problems - unhygienic conditions as well as agricultural problems - wins its trust and is accepted as one of them. Hence both I and II.

630680256291.explanation_en: 'Predictable' means able to be foreseen or expected. Its opposite is 'improbable' (unlikely to happen); foreseeable, certain and expected are all close in meaning to predictable.

630680256287.explanation_en: 'Miss the boat' means to lose an opportunity by being too slow to act. It has nothing to do with literal boat travel, so option 1, 'miss a chance', is correct.

630680256298.explanation_en: A introduces the crash of two MiG fighters, D reports where one plane crashed, C follows with 'the other fighter plane', and B describes the result (fire and injuries). So ADCB is the logical order.

630680256285.explanation_en: We walk 'along' or 'on' a beach, i.e. over its surface; 'through' implies moving inside something enclosed like a forest or tunnel. Hence 'through the beach' contains the error.

630680256296.explanation_en: An arsenal is a collection or store of weapons and military equipment. An archive stores records, an apiary is a place for keeping bees, and an asylum is a place of refuge.

630680256292.explanation_en: 'Heel' (noun) is the back part of the foot and 'heal' (verb) means to become healthy again. The sentence needs a noun first and a verb after 'will', so 'heel; heal' (option 3).

630680256299.explanation_en: D states the problem (library funds exhausted), C gives its consequence (no books till next session), B introduces a solution with 'However', and A states the solution. Hence DCBA.

630680256294.explanation_en: 'Hopping' suggests lively, energetic movement, which contradicts the slow, struggling recovery of air travel after Covid. 'Limping back to normalcy' is the standard expression for a slow, difficult recovery, so option 1.

630680256288.explanation_en: A person with a 'short fuse' gets angry very quickly, just as a short fuse makes an explosive go off quickly. Hence option 4.

630680256290.explanation_en: 'Crucial' is spelt correctly. The correct forms of the others are 'competence', 'command' and 'complexity'.

630680256295.explanation_en: 'Gear up for' means to prepare for an event, which fits the palace preparing for the winter festival. The sentence is already correct, so no substitution is required.

630680256293.explanation_en: The fixed collocation is 'fast train' (as in fast food, fast car). Speedy, brisk and quick are not used idiomatically with 'train' in this sense, so option 4.

630680256297.explanation_en: Anthropology is the study of human beings, including the evolution of mankind, their societies and cultures. Geology studies the earth, archaeology studies ancient remains, and cartography is map-making.

630680256286.explanation_en: 'Whether' introduces alternatives or doubt and cannot express contrast. A concessive clause needs 'Though/Although': 'Though I do not agree with her views, I respect her...'. So segment 4 has the error.

630680256289.explanation_en: The correct spelling is 'allot' (double l, single t). Associate, attendance and accept are spelt correctly, so 'Alott' is the incorrectly spelt word.

630680256302.explanation_en: The passage says 'A cyclist is an odd man out on the chaotic road, an unwelcome disruptor among the automobiles'. So the cyclist is referred to as the unwelcome disruptor.

630680256304.explanation_en: The writer mentions that cycling is carbon-free (eco-friendly), symbolises balanced living, and reduces stress. Nowhere does he say bicycles navigate traffic jams easily; in fact he says roads are unfriendly to cyclists. Hence option 3.

630680256303.explanation_en: 'Unfriendly' roads are those that are unwelcoming or unsuitable, i.e. 'inhospitable'. Estranged, aloof and lonely describe people's relationships or feelings, not roads.

630680256301.explanation_en: The WhatsApp exchange about finding a bicycle repair shop leads directly to the question 'Where have the bicycle repairers gone?'. It is a lively device to introduce the topic of disappearing cycle mechanics.

630680256305.explanation_en: Egalitarianism is the belief that all people are equal. The writer says a cyclist, unlike motorists who cocoon themselves, opens up to fellow travellers, so cycling culture symbolises the removal of inequalities among people.

630680256314.explanation_en: The word 'teen ber' is repeated with different meanings: first 'three times (meals)' and then 'three ber fruits'. Repetition of the same word with different meanings is Yamak alankar.
630680256314.explanation_hi: जहाँ एक ही शब्द बार-बार आए पर हर बार उसका अर्थ भिन्न हो, वहाँ यमक अलंकार होता है। यहाँ पहले 'तीन बेर' का अर्थ 'तीन बार (भोजन)' और दूसरे 'तीन बेर' का अर्थ 'बेर के तीन फल' है, अतः यमक अलंकार है।

630680256309.explanation_en: 'Vamavart' (vaam = left, aavart = turning) means turned or revolving towards the left. Vayavya refers to the north-west direction and vamoru means a woman with beautiful thighs.
630680256309.explanation_hi: 'वामावर्त' (वाम = बायाँ + आवर्त = घुमाव) का अर्थ है बायीं ओर को घूमा हुआ। 'वायव्य' उत्तर-पश्चिम दिशा तथा 'वामोरू' सुंदर जंघाओं वाली स्त्री के लिए प्रयुक्त होता है।

630680256316.explanation_en: The correct proverb is 'thokar lagi pahad ki, tode ghar ki sil': when someone is hurt by a powerful person, he vents his anger on the weak at home. 'Sil' (the grinding stone) is the right word, not 'seel' (dampness).
630680256316.explanation_hi: सही लोकोक्ति है 'ठोकर लगी पहाड़ की, तोड़े घर की सिल', अर्थात् बलवान से चोट खाकर अपना क्रोध घर के निर्बल पर उतारना। यहाँ 'सिल' (मसाला पीसने का पत्थर) शुद्ध है, 'सील' (नमी) नहीं।

630680256306.explanation_en: Option 1 is correct in word order and agreement. Option 2 has a jumbled order, option 3 breaks the 'jaisa ... vaisa' correlation, and option 4 places 'kam samman' wrongly.
630680256306.explanation_hi: विकल्प 1 का पदक्रम और अन्विति दोनों शुद्ध हैं। विकल्प 2 में पदक्रम बिगड़ा है, विकल्प 3 में 'जैसा...वैसा' का प्रयोग असंगत है और विकल्प 4 में 'कम सम्मान' का स्थान गलत है।

630680256311.explanation_en: 'Matrupadesh' is a yan sandhi: when 'ri' is followed by a dissimilar vowel it changes to 'r', so matri + upadesh = matrupadesh. Hence option 1.
630680256311.explanation_hi: 'मात्रुपदेश' में यण संधि है - 'ऋ' के बाद भिन्न स्वर आने पर 'ऋ' का 'र्' हो जाता है: मातृ + उपदेश = मात्रुपदेश (ऋ + उ = रु)। अतः शुद्ध संधि-विच्छेद 'मातृ + उपदेश' है।

630680256320.explanation_en: 'Naukar' (servant) is a Persian-origin word, so it is videshaj. Ghonsla, lota and jharokha are deshaj/tadbhav words of Indian origin.
630680256320.explanation_hi: 'नौकर' फ़ारसी भाषा से आया शब्द है, अतः यह विदेशज है। 'घोंसला', 'लोटा' और 'झरोखा' देशज शब्द हैं, इसलिए विकल्प 4 सही है।

630680256310.explanation_en: Karan karak denotes the instrument by which an action is done (sign 'se'). In 'kanon suni baat' the ears are the instrument of hearing (kanon se suni), so 'kanon' is in karan karak; meri/aapki show sambandh.
630680256310.explanation_hi: करण कारक क्रिया के साधन को बताता है (विभक्ति 'से')। 'कानों सुनी बात' अर्थात् कानों से सुनी गई बात - यहाँ सुनने का साधन कान है, अतः 'कानों' करण कारक है। 'मेरी', 'आपकी' संबंध कारक हैं।

630680256307.explanation_en: Option 1 has a natural and grammatical order of adverbial phrase, object and verb. The others are faulty: 'aadhar ke' should be 'aadhar par', 'alankar mein kavya mein' is garbled, and option 4 has a jumbled order.
630680256307.explanation_hi: विकल्प 1 का पदक्रम सही और स्वाभाविक है। विकल्प 2 में 'आधार के' के स्थान पर 'आधार पर' होना चाहिए, विकल्प 3 में 'अलंकार में काव्य में' असंगत है और विकल्प 4 का पदक्रम बिखरा हुआ है।

630680256313.explanation_en: The mind is compared to a peepal leaf trembling in the wind, and 'saris' (like) is the comparison word. An explicit comparison using a vachak shabd like sa/si/saris is Upama alankar.
630680256313.explanation_hi: यहाँ मन (उपमेय) की तुलना पीपल के पत्ते (उपमान) से की गई है, 'सरिस' वाचक शब्द है और 'डोलना' साधारण धर्म है। चारों अंग होने से यहाँ उपमा अलंकार है।

630680256318.explanation_en: 'Garal' means poison; its opposite is 'sudha' (nectar, amrit). Kalkoot is a synonym of poison, and viral means sparse.
630680256318.explanation_hi: 'गरल' का अर्थ है विष और इसका विलोम 'सुधा' (अमृत) है। 'कालकूट' विष का ही पर्याय है, 'विरल' का अर्थ है कम/छितरा हुआ।

630680256308.explanation_en: 'Athak' (tireless) naturally collocates with 'parishram' (hard work), and tireless labour with constant dedication leads any business to the peak. Gyan, vyavahar and jankari do not fit 'athak'.
630680256308.explanation_hi: 'अथक' (बिना थके) विशेषण के साथ 'परिश्रम' शब्द ही उपयुक्त है - अथक परिश्रम और सतत लगन से व्यवसाय चरम सीमा पर पहुँचता है। अन्य शब्द अर्थ की दृष्टि से संगत नहीं हैं।

630680256315.explanation_en: The correct idiom is 'jeebh par Saraswati basna', meaning someone whose words come true or who speaks very sweetly and wisely. Saraswati is the goddess of speech, so she replaces Lakshmi.
630680256315.explanation_hi: सही मुहावरा है 'जीभ पर सरस्वती बसना', अर्थात् वाणी का सत्य होना या मधुर और ज्ञानपूर्ण बोलना। सरस्वती वाणी की देवी हैं, इसलिए 'लक्ष्मी' के स्थान पर 'सरस्वती' सही है।

630680256317.explanation_en: 'Kshanbhangur' means perishable or short-lived; 'nashvar' (that which perishes) is its synonym. Yaksh is a semi-divine being, swatva means ownership and krish means thin.
630680256317.explanation_hi: 'क्षणभंगुर' का अर्थ है क्षण में नष्ट होने वाला; इसका पर्याय 'नश्वर' है। 'यक्ष' देवयोनि, 'स्वत्व' अधिकार तथा 'कृश' दुबला-पतला के अर्थ में आते हैं।

630680256312.explanation_en: In samahar dvandva the compound suggests the named items plus others of the same kind: 'seth-sahukar' means merchants, moneylenders and similar wealthy people. 'Stri-purush' is itaretar dvandva (just the two), and hrisht-pusht is a paired adjective.
630680256312.explanation_hi: समाहार द्वंद्व में दोनों पदों के साथ उसी प्रकार के अन्य का भी बोध होता है - 'सेठ-साहूकार' अर्थात् सेठ, साहूकार और ऐसे ही अन्य धनी लोग। 'स्त्री-पुरुष' इतरेतर द्वंद्व है (स्त्री और पुरुष), अतः विकल्प 1 सही है।

630680256319.explanation_en: 'Vardhaki' is the Sanskrit (tatsam) word for a carpenter, and its tadbhav form is 'badhai'. Hence option 3 completes the sentence.
630680256319.explanation_hi: 'वर्द्धकि' संस्कृत का तत्सम शब्द है जिसका अर्थ लकड़ी का काम करने वाला है; इसका तद्भव रूप 'बढ़ई' है। अतः विकल्प 3 सही है।

630680256325.explanation_en: The whole passage discusses Dr. Ramkumar Varma's one-act plays - their themes, idealism and craft. So 'Dr. Ramkumar Varma ke ekanki' is the most comprehensive title; the others cover only one aspect.
630680256325.explanation_hi: पूरा गद्यांश डॉ. रामकुमार वर्मा के एकांकियों - उनकी विषय-वस्तु, आदर्शवाद और शिल्प - पर केंद्रित है। अतः 'डॉ. रामकुमार वर्मा के एकांकी' सर्वाधिक उपयुक्त शीर्षक है; अन्य शीर्षक केवल एक पक्ष को छूते हैं।

630680256322.explanation_en: 'Praudhta' means maturity; its antonym is formed with the negative prefix 'a-': 'apraudhta' (immaturity). Paripakvata is a synonym, so option 1.
630680256322.explanation_hi: 'प्रौढ़ता' का अर्थ है परिपक्वता; इसका विलोम 'अ' उपसर्ग लगाकर 'अप्रौढ़ता' बनता है। 'परिपक्वता' इसका पर्यायवाची है, अतः विकल्प 1 सही है।

630680256326.explanation_en: The passage evaluates Varma's plays, pointing out strengths (craft, stageability) and weaknesses (excessive idealism, distance from reality). Such evaluative writing is in the critical (aalochanatmak) style.
630680256326.explanation_hi: गद्यांश में वर्मा जी के एकांकियों के गुण (शिल्प, अभिनेयता) और दोष (अतिशय आदर्शवाद, यथार्थ से दूरी) दोनों का मूल्यांकन किया गया है। गुण-दोष विवेचन वाली ऐसी शैली आलोचनात्मक शैली कहलाती है।

630680256324.explanation_en: 'Parinati' means outcome or end result. Option 2 uses it correctly: people liking you is the result of your behaviour. The other sentences confuse it with parinay (marriage), parinaam or avsar.
630680256324.explanation_hi: 'परिणति' का अर्थ है परिणाम या अंतिम फल। विकल्प 2 में 'आपके व्यवहार की परिणति' अर्थात् व्यवहार का परिणाम - सही प्रयोग है। अन्य वाक्यों में इसे 'परिणय', 'परिपक्वता' या 'अवसर' के अर्थ में गलत प्रयुक्त किया गया है।

630680256323.explanation_en: Pratishtha, aadar and aavbhagat all relate to honour or respectful treatment. 'Saranjam' means arrangement or equipment, so it is not a synonym of 'samman'.
630680256323.explanation_hi: 'प्रतिष्ठा', 'आदर' और 'आवभगत' सम्मान से संबंधित शब्द हैं। 'सरंजाम' का अर्थ है साज-सामान या प्रबंध, अतः यह 'सम्मान' का पर्यायवाची नहीं है।

630680256420.explanation_en: Under Sarva Shiksha Abhiyan's inclusive education component, children with special needs receive aids and appliances, Braille/large-print textbooks, and girls with disabilities are given stipends to support their schooling. Hence both are correct.

630680256422.explanation_en: Positive reinforcement adds a pleasant stimulus after a desired behaviour to increase its occurrence. Awarding high grades is a reward, while finding loopholes, detention and threats are punishments or aversive stimuli.

630680256423.explanation_en: Lower (controlled/guided) forms of writing include copying, dictation, picture composition and guided writing. Paragraph writing is treated as a higher form of composition requiring organisation of ideas, so per the official key it does not belong to the lower forms.

630680256417.explanation_en: Piaget saw play as natural, biologically based and universal across cultures and ages, arising from assimilation. Children can play without toys (pretend and imaginative play), so the claim that play is impossible without toys is not correct.

630680256418.explanation_en: Fast mapping is the process by which children quickly connect a new word to its meaning after only one or two exposures, rapidly expanding vocabulary. Sorting is a classification skill, not a vocabulary-building process, so only I.

630680256425.explanation_en: In Kilpatrick's project method, students themselves purpose (set the objective), plan, execute and judge a purposeful activity, learning by doing. Hence the project method.

630680256419.explanation_en: 'Kesari' was started by Bal Gangadhar Tilak in 1881 in Marathi; its English counterpart was 'Mahratta'. Hence Marathi.

630680256424.explanation_en: Section 82 of the Indian Penal Code (doli incapax) states that nothing is an offence which is done by a child under seven years of age. Hence 7 years.

630680256426.explanation_en: Research consistently shows that parent and family involvement increases students' achievement and success; it does not decrease them. So neither statement is correct.

630680256421.explanation_en: Generality of thought, idealism and propositional (hypothetico-deductive) reasoning are characteristics of the formal operational stage (11+ years), when adolescents think abstractly.

630680256565.explanation_en: Collins defined 'permacrisis' as 'an extended period of instability and insecurity'. 'Extended period' is the natural collocation for a long-lasting stretch of time; 'lengthened' and 'elongated' describe physical stretching, so option 4 fits best.

630680256569.explanation_en: A introduces the story of the unhappy telephone booth, C describes people failing to open its door, B brings in the boy who sang, and D gives the result - the door opened. Hence ACBD.

630680256558.explanation_en: 'Break even' means to reach a point where income equals expenditure, so there is neither profit nor loss. Hence option 2.

630680256563.explanation_en: 'Fully aware' is the standard collocation meaning completely conscious of something. 'Outrightly' is non-standard, and 'utterly' and 'positively' do not idiomatically pair with 'aware' here.

630680256555.explanation_en: Coffee is poured 'from' a flask 'into' the cups; the source takes 'from'. So 'into the flask' should be 'from the flask', making option 3 the error.

630680256564.explanation_en: 'Scorching heat' is the standard collocation for intense summer heat. 'Flaming' refers to actual flames, 'ardent' means passionate and 'crackling' is a sound, so option 3 is the best substitute.

630680256559.explanation_en: The correct spelling is 'university' with an s. Unison, unpredictable and universal are spelt correctly, so 'Univercity' is incorrect.

630680256560.explanation_en: 'Permeate' (to spread through) is correctly spelt. The others should be 'pension', 'persuasion' and 'permission'.

630680256566.explanation_en: Chronology (chronos = time) is the arrangement of events or dates in the order in which they occurred. Phonology studies speech sounds, geology the earth, and morphology word forms or structures.

630680256568.explanation_en: A gives Braille's birth, D says he lost his eyesight at three due to an accident, C explains how the accident happened, and B says doctors could not save his eyes. Hence ADCB.

630680256561.explanation_en: 'Liberation' means setting free. Its opposite is 'subjugation' (bringing under control or domination); emancipation, acquittal and freedom are similar in meaning.

630680256557.explanation_en: 'Face the music' means to accept and confront the unpleasant consequences of one's actions. Hence option 1, 'confront unpleasantness'.

630680256567.explanation_en: A dormitory is a large bedroom with many beds for students or members of an institution. A creche is a nursery for infants, a hostel is a whole residential building, and a sanatorium is a place for convalescents.

630680256556.explanation_en: After the gerund 'being', a complement adjective is needed: 'her being honest'. 'Honesty' is a noun and cannot follow 'being' here, so segment 1 is incorrect.

630680256562.explanation_en: 'Meet' (verb) means to come together, and 'meat' (noun) is animal flesh. The sentence needs a verb after 'Let us' and a noun modifier for 'shop', giving 'meet; meat'.

630680256571.explanation_en: The story shows a line can be made smaller by drawing a bigger one beside it, and the writer states the moral: to win you need not cut others down. So it conveys that one can win without defeating anyone.

630680256572.explanation_en: In 'sometimes subtle and sometimes very obvious competition', subtle is the opposite of obvious, meaning not openly expressed, i.e. implied. Thin and delicate are physical senses, so option 4 fits.

630680256573.explanation_en: The passage lists quiet quitting (doing the bare minimum), leaving, mental health problems and even suicides as outcomes of toxic competition. Speaking up against unfairness is mentioned only as a remedy, not a consequence.

630680256574.explanation_en: The writer criticises pleasing bosses and earning favours, and calls for equitable growth opportunities and freedom to speak up. So he would not agree with allowing bosses to have personal preferences.

630680256575.explanation_en: The passage explains a workplace problem - unfair competition - its causes, effects and possible remedies in an informative way. Writing that explains and informs on a topic is expository.

630680256589.explanation_en: 'Poonji' (capital, wealth) is a tadbhav word derived from Sanskrit 'punj'. The sentence means a person's best wealth is his good deeds; the other options are tatsam or unrelated.
630680256589.explanation_hi: 'पूँजी' तद्भव शब्द है (संस्कृत 'पुञ्ज' से)। वाक्य का अर्थ है - मनुष्य की सबसे बड़ी संपत्ति उसके अच्छे कर्म हैं। 'पुंज', 'पुच्छ', 'पृच्छन' तत्सम हैं और अर्थ की दृष्टि से भी उपयुक्त नहीं हैं।

630680256578.explanation_en: 'Atmotsarg' (atma + utsarg = self-sacrifice) means giving up one's own pleasures for the happiness of others. Atmaghat is suicide and atmotkarsh is self-elevation, so option 3.
630680256578.explanation_hi: 'आत्मोत्सर्ग' (आत्म + उत्सर्ग) का अर्थ है दूसरों के सुख के लिए अपने सुखों का त्याग। 'आत्मघात' आत्महत्या को और 'आत्मोत्कर्ष' अपनी उन्नति को कहते हैं, अतः विकल्प 3 सही है।

630680256585.explanation_en: 'Urbasi' appears with different meanings: first as Urvashi the celestial nymph, and then as 'ur basi' (dwelling in Krishna's heart). Repetition of a word with different meanings is Yamak alankar.
630680256585.explanation_hi: इस दोहे में 'उरबसी' शब्द बार-बार आया है पर अर्थ भिन्न हैं - एक बार 'उर्वशी' अप्सरा और दूसरी बार 'उर बसी' (हृदय में बसी हुई)। एक शब्द की भिन्न अर्थों में आवृत्ति यमक अलंकार है।

630680256588.explanation_en: Srijan and rachna both mean creation, so they are synonyms, not opposites. The other pairs are proper antonyms (sugati-durgati, saumya-ugra, srishti-pralay).
630680256588.explanation_hi: 'सृजन' और 'रचना' दोनों का अर्थ निर्माण है, अतः ये पर्यायवाची हैं, विलोम नहीं। सुगति-दुर्गति, सौम्य-उग्र और सृष्टि-प्रलय सही विलोम युग्म हैं।

630680256576.explanation_en: In Hindi the verb comes at the end, with the subject and its modifiers before it. 'Bal Gopal ke sir par ghunghrale kuntal shobha de rahe hain' follows this order; the others displace the verb.
630680256576.explanation_hi: हिंदी वाक्य में क्रिया सामान्यतः अंत में आती है। 'बाल गोपाल के सिर पर घुँघराले कुंतल शोभा दे रहे हैं' में स्थानवाचक पद, कर्ता और क्रिया अपने सही क्रम में हैं; अन्य विकल्पों में क्रिया का स्थान गलत है।

630680256586.explanation_en: The standard idiom is 'munh mein pani bhar aana', meaning to feel a strong desire (especially for tasty food). The other versions replace 'pani' with words not used in the idiom.
630680256586.explanation_hi: शुद्ध मुहावरा है 'मुँह में पानी भर आना', जिसका अर्थ है - किसी स्वादिष्ट वस्तु को देखकर उसे पाने की तीव्र इच्छा होना। अन्य विकल्पों में 'पानी' के स्थान पर गलत शब्द रखे गए हैं।

630680256584.explanation_en: The horses of the Raghu clan are imagined as if they want to kiss the chariot of the Sun; 'manon' is a typical vachak word of possibility. Imagining the upmeya as the upman with words like manu/manon/janu is Utpreksha alankar.
630680256584.explanation_hi: यहाँ रघुवंशियों के बलवान घोड़ों के बारे में संभावना व्यक्त की गई है मानो वे सूर्य के रथ को चूमना चाहते हैं। 'मनों' (मानो) उत्प्रेक्षा का वाचक शब्द है; जहाँ उपमेय में उपमान की संभावना की जाए वहाँ उत्प्रेक्षा अलंकार होता है।

630680256581.explanation_en: 'Ullanghan' is a vyanjan sandhi: when 't' of 'ut' is followed by 'l', it changes to 'l', so ut + langhan = ullanghan. Hence option 1.
630680256581.explanation_hi: 'उल्लंघन' में व्यंजन संधि है - 'त्' के बाद 'ल' आने पर 'त्' का 'ल्' हो जाता है: उत् + लंघन = उल्लंघन (जैसे उत् + लास = उल्लास)। अतः विकल्प 1 सही है।

630680256583.explanation_en: 'Girahkat' means one who cuts the knot (a pickpocket). The object 'girah' takes the 'ko' sign, so it is a karm tatpurush: 'girah ko katne wala'.
630680256583.explanation_hi: 'गिरहकट' का अर्थ है गाँठ (गिरह) काटने वाला अर्थात् जेबकतरा। यहाँ 'गिरह' कर्म है और कर्म कारक का चिह्न 'को' लुप्त है, अतः विग्रह 'गिरह को काटनेवाला' (कर्म तत्पुरुष) होगा।

630680256577.explanation_en: Option 4 follows the natural Hindi order: time adverb (is samay), subject (tumhare padosi), complement phrase and verb at the end. The other options place the verb or adverb in the middle.
630680256577.explanation_hi: विकल्प 4 में कालवाचक पद (इस समय), कर्ता (तुम्हारे पड़ोसी), पूरक (तुम्हारी सहायता करने वाले एकमात्र व्यक्ति) और अंत में क्रिया (हैं) - यह स्वाभाविक हिंदी पदक्रम है। अन्य विकल्पों में क्रिया बीच में आ गई है।

630680256580.explanation_en: The face-to-face presence of the narrator and listener was an essential feature of the old oral 'katha' tradition. 'Anivarya' (essential) fits the sense; samanya, aakasmik and anavashyak do not.
630680256580.explanation_hi: पुरानी 'कथा' मौखिक परंपरा थी, जिसमें कहने वाले और सुनने वाले का आमने-सामने होना आवश्यक था। अतः 'अनिवार्य' विशेषता सर्वोचित है; 'सामान्य', 'आकस्मिक' और 'अनावश्यक' अर्थ से मेल नहीं खाते।

630680256587.explanation_en: The correct proverb is 'apni naak kate to kate, doosron ka sagun to bigde' - harming oneself just to spoil another's good fortune. 'Naak' (honour) is the word used in this proverb.
630680256587.explanation_hi: शुद्ध लोकोक्ति है 'अपनी नाक कटे तो कटे, दूसरों का सगुन तो बिगड़े', अर्थात् अपनी हानि सहकर भी दूसरे का काम बिगाड़ना। इसमें 'नाक' (प्रतिष्ठा) शब्द ही प्रयुक्त होता है।

630680256590.explanation_en: 'Aurat' is an Arabic word, so 'auraton' is the foreign-origin option. Stri, naari and mahila are Sanskrit-origin (tatsam) words.
630680256590.explanation_hi: 'औरत' अरबी भाषा का शब्द है, अतः 'औरतों' विदेशी शब्द है। 'स्त्री', 'नारी' और 'महिला' संस्कृत के तत्सम शब्द हैं।

630680256582.explanation_en: In 'yathasheeghra' (as soon as possible) the first member 'yatha' is an indeclinable (avyay) and dominates the meaning, and the whole compound works as an adverb. This is avyayibhav samas.
630680256582.explanation_hi: 'यथाशीघ्र' (जितना शीघ्र हो सके) में पहला पद 'यथा' अव्यय है और वही प्रधान है; पूरा पद क्रियाविशेषण की तरह प्रयुक्त होता है। अतः यहाँ अव्ययीभाव समास है।

630680256579.explanation_en: 'Chakshush' (from chakshu = eye) means relating to the eyes or visual. Netrant means the corner of the eye, and the other two are not standard words.
630680256579.explanation_hi: 'चाक्षुष' (चक्षु = आँख) का अर्थ है आँखों से संबंधित या आँखों से देखा जाने वाला। 'नेत्रांत' आँख का कोना है, शेष शब्द मानक नहीं हैं, अतः विकल्प 4 सही है।

630680256595.explanation_en: The Karachi resolution promised equality of all before the law irrespective of caste, creed or sex. So the claim that separate laws for men and women were recognised is false (option 2).
630680256595.explanation_hi: गद्यांश के अनुसार कराची प्रस्ताव में जाति, पंथ और लिंग के भेद के बिना क़ानून के समक्ष सबकी समानता की बात कही गई थी। अतः महिलाओं और पुरुषों के लिए भिन्न-भिन्न क़ानून की बात असत्य है।

630680256593.explanation_en: The last line of the passage says that in 1939 Subhas Chandra Bose founded the Forward Bloc. Hence option 4.
630680256593.explanation_hi: गद्यांश की अंतिम पंक्ति के अनुसार 1939 में सुभाषचंद्र बोस ने 'फॉरवर्ड ब्लॉक' की स्थापना की। अतः विकल्प 4 सही है।

630680256594.explanation_en: People turned to Marxism and socialism because the worldwide depression discredited capitalism while Soviet industry grew fourfold. Capitalism's 'achievements' being highlighted was not a reason - the passage says the opposite.
630680256594.explanation_hi: गद्यांश के अनुसार विश्वव्यापी मंदी से पूँजीवादी प्रणाली बदनाम हुई और सोवियत संघ का उत्पादन चार गुना बढ़ा, इसलिए लोग समाजवाद की ओर मुड़े। पूँजीवादी व्यवस्था की उपलब्धियाँ उजागर होना कारण नहीं था, अतः विकल्प 4 सही है।

630680256596.explanation_en: The resolution promised remission of rent for uneconomic holdings, not equal rent for them. So the statement that equal rent would be fixed even for unprofitable and barren holdings is false (option 3).
630680256596.explanation_hi: प्रस्ताव में लाभहीन जोतों के लिए लगान माफी का वादा था, समान लगान का नहीं। अतः 'लाभहीन तथा बंजर जोतों के लिए भी समान लगान' वाला कथन असत्य है।

630680256592.explanation_en: The passage says the 1929 depression caused a big fall in production and foreign trade and widespread unemployment, and that people's economic condition worsened. So the effect that did NOT occur is option 4 (economic condition became stronger); the official key, option 2 (decline in foreign trade), is explicitly stated in the passage as an effect.
630680256592.explanation_hi: गद्यांश में स्पष्ट लिखा है कि मंदी से उत्पादन और विदेशी व्यापार में भारी गिरावट आई, बेरोज़गारी फैली और जनता की आर्थिक स्थिति खराब हुई। अतः जो प्रभाव नहीं पड़ा वह विकल्प 4 (आर्थिक स्थिति सुदृढ़ होना) है; आधिकारिक उत्तर विकल्प 2 (विदेशी व्यापार में कमी) तो गद्यांश में बताया गया प्रभाव ही है।

630680256688.explanation_en: Obesity is a risk factor for lifestyle disorders such as high blood pressure, diabetes and joint/orthopaedic problems. AIDS is caused by the HIV virus, not by obesity.

630680256691.explanation_en: When learners construct meaning themselves, the process is constructivist and student-centred; the teacher only facilitates. Hence option 1.

630680256694.explanation_en: Performing arts need open space where children can move and see one another, not a clear view of the board. The other pairings - CWSN seated near the board, clustered seating for group work, eye contact in discussion - are correct.

630680256695.explanation_en: The Integrated Child Development Services scheme provides supplementary nutrition through anganwadis to children below six years (too young for school), and to pregnant and lactating mothers.

630680256696.explanation_en: Helping with decoration during school or community events is a service activity contributing to the community. The other options are information-collection or project activities.

630680256687.explanation_en: Newborns turn their eyes and head towards a sound source, showing that auditory-visual coordination is present from birth, though it becomes more refined over the following months.

630680256690.explanation_en: Concept-map construction with software, multimedia program development and computer-based testing all use ICT. Writing a reflection journal on paper is a traditional, non-ICT method.

630680256692.explanation_en: Calling all four-legged animals 'doggie' is over-generalisation (overextension), while using 'duck' only for one's own toy duck is under-generalisation (underextension). Both pairs are wrongly matched, so neither is correct.

630680256689.explanation_en: The District Primary Education Programme (launched 1994) added an Integrated Education for Disabled Children/inclusive education component in 1997. Hence 1997.

630680256693.explanation_en: In James Marcia's model, identity moratorium is the status of adolescents who are in crisis - actively exploring and experimenting with alternatives - but have not yet made commitments.

630680599693.explanation_en: 'Obstinate' means stubbornly refusing to change one's opinion or course. 'Headstrong' (self-willed, stubborn) is its synonym; agreeable is nearly the opposite, and devilish and joyful are unrelated.

630680599694.explanation_en: To 'quarantine' is to isolate or keep apart, especially to prevent the spread of disease. 'Assimilate' means to absorb or integrate into a group, which is the opposite idea.

630680599675.explanation_en: A question tag repeats the auxiliary of the main clause with the same subject pronoun and opposite polarity. The main clause 'You can't hear...' is negative with 'can', so the tag is the positive 'can you?'.

630680599687.explanation_en: The correct spellings are 'compliance', 'traffic' and 'necessary'. Only option 4 has all three correct; the others contain 'neccesary', 'trafic' or 'complience'.

630680599691.explanation_en: 'Friendly' means kind and pleasant towards others; its opposite is 'hostile' (unfriendly, aggressive). Igneous, scorching and mammoth are unrelated in meaning.

630680599682.explanation_en: 'Developing basic' is followed by Q 'infrastructure and the production sector', then P 'is the only way to face an', S 'economic crisis and the Centre has the', and R 'responsibility to help states'. Hence QPSR.

630680599690.explanation_en: 'Call it a day' means to stop working on something, usually because one has done enough or is tired. It fits a team stopping after six hours of continuous work.

630680599685.explanation_en: The correct forms are 'reach', 'consensus' and 'issue'. Only option 4 spells all of them correctly; the others have 'rich', 'isue', 'essue' or 'conssensus'.

630680599684.explanation_en: Q gives the historical background (natural lightning fires), R adds that Native Americans also burned the prairie, P describes how settlers began extinguishing fires, and S says fire has returned as controlled burns in the last 50 years. Hence QRPS.

630680599679.explanation_en: 'Chewed' is a verb, and a verb is modified by an adverb, not an adjective. So the adverb 'slowly' is correct.

630680599678.explanation_en: The verb 'brim' takes the preposition 'with': 'eyes brimmed with tears' means filled to the edge with tears. Hence option 1.

630680599681.explanation_en: The sentence needs a duration expression, 'for thousands of years'. Among the given choices only 'for' is acceptable; 'for since', 'of from' and 'from of' are ungrammatical combinations (ideally the sentence would read 'benefited from for thousands of years').

630680599680.explanation_en: 'Take to the streets' is an idiom meaning to go out into public places to protest. Residents protesting the mayor's kidnapping 'took to the streets'; 'took on' means to accept a challenge.

630680599677.explanation_en: The main clause 'She was wearing...' is positive with the auxiliary 'was' and subject 'she', so the tag is negative: 'wasn't she?'.

630680599688.explanation_en: 'Roll up one's sleeves' means to prepare for hard work. 'Drag one's feet' means to delay, and 'back to square one' means to start again, so option 2 fits best.

630680599696.explanation_en: The passage highlights India's rapidly increasing population - figures on births and annual additions - and links it to unemployment, poverty and backwardness. So the main idea is population explosion and its resulting problems.

630680599699.explanation_en: The passage says that with such a huge population India finds it difficult to succeed in employment, alleviation of poverty and backwardness. So all three - I, II and III - are correct.

630680599697.explanation_en: 'Adding an Australia every year' means India's annual population increase equals the whole population of Australia. Hence option 4.

630680599698.explanation_en: 'Alleviation' means reducing or lessening a problem; in context 'alleviation of poverty' means removing poverty. 'Eradicate' (to remove) is the closest in meaning among the options, while 'intensify' is the opposite.

630680599700.explanation_en: 'Extinct' means no longer existing. Its opposite is 'prevailing' (currently existing or widespread), as in 'this prevailing trend'. Lost, obsolete and defunct are synonyms of extinct.

630680600014.explanation_en: Part 2 begins the idea ('to convey things deep into children's tender minds'), 4 completes it ('what better way than stories, especially Panchatantra's'), 1 continues with 'stories which contain lessons...', and 3 ends the sentence. Hence 2,4,1,3.
630680600014.explanation_hi: भाग 2 से वाक्य शुरू होता है (बच्चों के कोमल मन में बातों को गहराई तक पहुँचाने का), फिर 4 (तरीका कहानियों से बेहतर...खासकर पंचतंत्र की), फिर 1 (कहानियां, जिसमें बेहतर सीख...) और अंत में 3 (की ओर बढ़ने की प्रेरणा मौजूद होती है)। अतः क्रम 2,4,1,3 है।

630680600010.explanation_en: 'Tukur-tukur dekhna' means to stare continuously, looking fixedly at something with longing or helplessness. So 'taktaki lagakar dekhna' is the meaning.
630680600010.explanation_hi: 'टुकुर-टुकुर देखना' का अर्थ है लगातार एकटक या टकटकी लगाकर देखना, प्रायः लालसा या असहायता के भाव से। अतः विकल्प 4 सही है।

630680600021.explanation_en: 'Teenon lokon' (all three worlds) uses the numeral adjective 'teenon' qualifying 'lok'. Swabhav is a noun, jisko a pronoun, and 'pratyek' does not suit the plural 'lokon' idiomatically.
630680600021.explanation_hi: 'तीनों लोकों में' - यहाँ 'तीनों' संख्यावाचक विशेषण है जो 'लोकों' की विशेषता बताता है। 'स्वभाव' संज्ञा और 'जिसको' सर्वनाम है, जबकि 'प्रत्येक' बहुवचन 'लोकों' के साथ उपयुक्त नहीं है।

630680600009.explanation_en: 'Taul-taul kar munh se shabd nikalna' means to speak very carefully, weighing each word. Hence option 3.
630680600009.explanation_hi: 'तौल-तौल कर मुँह से शब्द निकालना' का अर्थ है बहुत सोच-विचार कर, नाप-तौल कर बोलना। अतः विकल्प 3 सही है।

630680600015.explanation_en: 'Praman' = pra + maan; due to the preceding 'r' in 'pra', the dental 'n' becomes retroflex 'n' (natva vidhan). Hence option 3.
630680600015.explanation_hi: 'प्रमाण' का संधि-विच्छेद 'प्र + मान' है। 'प्र' में 'र' होने के कारण णत्व विधान से 'मान' का 'न' 'ण' में बदल जाता है (जैसे प्र + नाम = प्रणाम)।

630680600011.explanation_en: 'Apna haath Jagannath' means that work done with one's own hands is the best and most reliable - self-help is best. Hence option 3.
630680600011.explanation_hi: 'अपना हाथ जगन्नाथ' का अर्थ है - अपने हाथ से किया गया काम ही सबसे अच्छा और भरोसेमंद होता है, अर्थात् स्वावलंबन सर्वश्रेष्ठ है। अतः विकल्प 3 सही है।

630680600012.explanation_en: Part 1 sets the scene (afternoon of Ashwin, Ramlila), 3 says the narrator was at a friend's house playing cards, 2 tells of a man arriving and asking for him, and 4 completes it (sat beside him; the narrator didn't know him). Hence 1,3,2,4.
630680600012.explanation_hi: भाग 1 में समय और वातावरण (आश्विन का तीसरा पहर, रामलीला) का परिचय है, 3 में लेखक के दोस्त के घर ताश खेलने की बात, 2 में एक व्यक्ति के आने की घटना और 4 में उसके बगल में बैठने की बात है। अतः क्रम 1,3,2,4 है।

630680600020.explanation_en: Hearts are won through love, so the abstract noun 'pyar' fits: 'Mahi won everyone's heart with her love'. Lakdi, prarthana and plastic do not suit the sense.
630680600020.explanation_hi: दिल जीतने का साधन 'प्यार' होता है - 'माही ने आते ही प्यार से सबका दिल जीत लिया।' यहाँ 'प्यार' भाववाचक संज्ञा है; अन्य विकल्प अर्थ की दृष्टि से उपयुक्त नहीं हैं।

630680600004.explanation_en: 'Lambodar' (one with a large belly) is a synonym of Ganesh, along with Gajanan, Vinayak and Ekdant. Neerad means cloud, Chakrapani is Vishnu, and Kaushalendra is Ram.
630680600004.explanation_hi: 'लम्बोदर' (बड़े पेट वाले) गणेश का पर्यायवाची है; अन्य पर्याय - गजानन, विनायक, एकदंत। 'नीरद' बादल, 'चक्रपाणि' विष्णु और 'कौशलेन्द्र' राम का पर्याय है।

630680600002.explanation_en: 'Gun' has several meanings - quality/characteristic (visheshta), rope or string, the three gunas (sattva, rajas, tamas) and multiplication. Among the options, 'visheshta' is one of its meanings.
630680600002.explanation_hi: 'गुण' अनेकार्थी शब्द है - विशेषता, रस्सी/डोरी, सत्त्व-रज-तम तीन गुण, गुणा आदि। दिए गए विकल्पों में 'विशेषता' इसका एक अर्थ है, अतः विकल्प 4 सही है।

630680600007.explanation_en: 'Moksh' means liberation from worldly bondage; its opposite is 'bandhan' (bondage). Khagol, shashvat and sabhya are unrelated.
630680600007.explanation_hi: 'मोक्ष' का अर्थ है सांसारिक बंधनों से मुक्ति, अतः इसका विलोम 'बंधन' है। खगोल, शाश्वत और सभ्य का इससे कोई विलोम संबंध नहीं है।

630680600019.explanation_en: The box belongs to the sweets, so the possessive (sambandh karak) is used. Since 'dibba' is masculine and in the oblique case before 'mein', the form is 'ke': 'mithai ke dibbe mein se'.
630680600019.explanation_hi: यहाँ डिब्बे का मिठाई से संबंध है, अतः संबंध कारक चाहिए। 'डिब्बे' पुल्लिंग है और 'में' परसर्ग से पहले तिर्यक रूप में है, इसलिए 'का' के स्थान पर 'के' आएगा - 'मिठाई के डब्बे में से'।

630680600017.explanation_en: 'Ityadi' is a yan sandhi: when 'i' is followed by a dissimilar vowel it changes to 'y', so iti + aadi = ityadi. Hence option 4.
630680600017.explanation_hi: 'इत्यादि' में यण संधि है - 'इ' के बाद भिन्न स्वर आने पर 'इ' का 'य्' हो जाता है: इति + आदि = इत्यादि। अतः विकल्प 4 सही है।

630680600018.explanation_en: Teeth chatter in the cold, and the verb used for this is 'katkatana'. Langdana means to limp, sathiyana means to become senile, and teeth are not said to 'kaampna'.
630680600018.explanation_hi: ठंड में दाँतों के आपस में बजने के लिए 'कटकटाना' क्रिया प्रयुक्त होती है - 'ठंड के मारे मेरे दाँत भी कटकटाने लगे।' 'लंगड़ाना', 'सठियाना' और 'कांपना' दाँतों के लिए उपयुक्त नहीं हैं।

630680600006.explanation_en: 'Rama' is a name of the goddess Lakshmi, and 'Shri' is also a synonym of Lakshmi (others: Kamla, Padma, Indira). Nisha means night, phool means flower and katak means army.
630680600006.explanation_hi: 'रमा' लक्ष्मी का पर्याय है और 'श्री' भी लक्ष्मी का ही पर्याय है (अन्य - कमला, पद्मा, इंदिरा)। 'निशा' रात, 'फूल' पुष्प और 'कटक' सेना का अर्थ देते हैं।

630680600001.explanation_en: The passage explains how climate change is forcing Alpine ibex to shift to night-time activity, exposing them to predators and possibly reducing their population. So option 2 states the central theme.
630680600001.explanation_hi: गद्यांश बताता है कि जलवायु परिवर्तन के कारण अल्पाइन आइबेक्स रात्रिचर बन रहे हैं, जिससे शिकार का खतरा बढ़ रहा है और उनकी जनसंख्या घट सकती है। अतः केन्द्रीय विषय विकल्प 2 है।

630680599998.explanation_en: The passage says the change in behaviour is increasing the risk of predation, not reducing it. So option 2 is the statement not supported by the passage; the others are stated directly.
630680599998.explanation_hi: गद्यांश के अनुसार व्यवहार पैटर्न में बदलाव से शिकार के जोखिम में वृद्धि हो रही है, कमी नहीं। अतः विकल्प 2 का तथ्य गद्यांश में नहीं है; शेष तथ्य गद्यांश में सीधे दिए गए हैं।

630680600000.explanation_en: 'Parivartan' means change; its opposite is 'sthirta' (stability, constancy). The other words are unrelated.
630680600000.explanation_hi: 'परिवर्तन' का अर्थ है बदलाव, अतः इसका विलोम 'स्थिरता' है। 'प्रवर', 'बहुज्ञ' और 'प्रस्थान' का इससे विलोम संबंध नहीं है।

630680599997.explanation_en: 'Jeevanshaili' (lifestyle) means the characteristic way of living of a person, group or culture. Hence option 2; the others narrow it to roaming, changing or staying.
630680599997.explanation_hi: 'जीवनशैली' का अर्थ है किसी व्यक्ति, समूह या संस्कृति के जीने का विशिष्ट तरीका। अन्य विकल्प केवल घूमने, बदलने या ठहरने तक सीमित हैं, अतः विकल्प 2 सही है।

630680599999.explanation_en: 'Praman' means proof or evidence; its synonym is 'sakshya'. Mithya (false), kritrim (artificial) and kalpanik (imaginary) are opposite in sense.
630680599999.explanation_hi: 'प्रमाण' का अर्थ है सबूत, अतः इसका पर्यायवाची 'साक्ष्य' है। 'मिथ्या', 'कृत्रिम' और 'काल्पनिक' अर्थ में इसके विपरीत हैं।

630680598531.explanation_en: Piaget's pre-operational stage spans roughly 2 to 7 years, marked by symbolic thought, egocentrism and lack of conservation. Hence option 2.

630680598534.explanation_en: The Government of India adopted the National Policy for the Empowerment of Women in 2001, which was also declared the Year of Women's Empowerment.

630680598535.explanation_en: Learning by doing through varied activities that actively engage learners is the hallmark of the student-centred (constructivist) approach. The teacher-centred approach relies mainly on lecture and transmission.

630680598537.explanation_en: Peer assessment is when classmates evaluate a learner's responses and performance, giving feedback to one another. Self-assessment is by the learner himself and teacher-led assessment is by the teacher.

630680598532.explanation_en: The 71st Constitutional Amendment (1992) added Konkani, Manipuri and Nepali to the Eighth Schedule. Boro was added later by the 92nd Amendment (2003), and Bengali and Gujarati were original languages.

630680598540.explanation_en: Art education covers both the visual/tangible arts (drawing, painting, sculpture, crafts) and the performing arts (music, dance, drama). Hence both I and II.

630680598533.explanation_en: In the subject-centred approach, teaching and learning activities are strictly confined to the prescribed content or textbook of the subject. Learner-centred approaches go beyond the textbook to learners' needs and experiences.

630680598539.explanation_en: Piaget's four stages - sensorimotor, pre-operational, concrete operational and formal operational - describe cognitive (intellectual) development. Hence option 3.

630680598538.explanation_en: Standard IQ ranges are: mild about 50/55-70/75, moderate 35-49, severe 20-34 and profound below 20. So profound = below 20, mild = 50-75, severe = 20-34, giving I-2, II-3, III-1.

630680598536.explanation_en: A diorama is a three-dimensional full-size or scale model of a scene (historical event, nature or cityscape), often displayed in museums. Realia are real objects, and globes are spherical maps.
